einstellungen.text: In 1925, a man sold the Eiffel Tower.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: The Eiffel Tower in Paris in 1925 at dusk, light rain, Parisians with umbrellas below, low angle
einstellungen.video_prompt: slow push in towards the tower, rain falling

einstellungen.text: Con man Victor Lustig told scrap dealers it was being torn down.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A dramatized 1920s con man in a three-piece suit leaning across a hotel table toward nervous businessmen, cinematic reenactment

einstellungen.text: One buyer paid. Lustig fled with the money.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: A leather briefcase full of 1920s banknotes on a train seat, landscape blurring outside the window

einstellungen.text: Then he came back and tried it again.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: The con man stepping off a train at a busy 1920s Paris station through steam, confident walk
einstellungen.video_prompt: he walks toward camera through the steam

einstellungen.text: The Eiffel Tower is still standing. Still not for sale.
